text:
sam: quick during pricing Q&A - can we clarify trial limits vs paid?

ivy: TL;DR: rate limits = realtime throttles (req/sec, concurrency); quotas = period-based caps (tokens/embeddings/month). trials get lower quotas and conservative rate limits.

sam: are embeddings and chat in the same quota?

leo: separate quota lines by default. we have some promotional pooled credits for special cases.

sam: what happens when trial hits quota mid-session? auto-upgrade or blocked?

billing-bot: system: trials receive dashboard modal and email at 85% and 100% usage; requests beyond hard quota return 429 (quota_exceeded) or 402 when auto-billing failed.

ivy: we do NOT auto-charge trials. paid customers with card can opt into auto-topup addon. ops+sales must enable for pilot accounts.

sam: can credits increase quota?

leo: credits apply to billing balance only. we have a manual ops flow to convert credits into temporary quota increases for strategic customers.

sam: SDKs expect a stable error payload - what's the schema?

ivy: standard: 429 -> {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":int}, quota -> {"error":"quota_exceeded","retry_after":int,"quota_type":"tokens|embeddings"}, 402 -> {"error":"insufficient_funds"}. will add examples to API docs.

sam: any plan to expose remaining quota to apps? mobile team asked.

leo: proposing optional header X-Remaining-Quota and a /v1/usage admin endpoint. header opt-in for privacy; usage endpoint requires admin scope.

all-hands-bot: follow-ups created: #3421 api:quota-headers, #3422 onboarding:quota-playbook, #3423 marketing:trial-email-update

sam: great, thanks. please drop the docs snippet and error examples in the doc issue. :thumbsup:

ivy: noted. we'll add a short snippet for SDKs and a sample retry pattern.
